abstract_sentences.text: Diffusion-based generative models have reformed generative AI, and also enabled new capabilities in the science domain, e.g., fast generation of 3D structures of molecules.

evidence.anchor: enabled new capabilities in the science domain

abstract_sentences.text: In such tasks, there is often a symmetry in the system, identifying elements that can be converted by certain transformations as equivalent.

evidence.anchor: elements converted by transformations as equivalent

abstract_sentences.text: Equivariant diffusion models guarantee a symmetric distribution, but miss the opportunity to make learning easier, while alignment-based simplification attempts fail to preserve the target distribution.

evidence.anchor: alignment-based attempts fail to preserve target distribution

abstract_sentences.text: In this work, we develop quotient-space diffusion models, a principled generative framework to fully handle and leverage symmetry.

By viewing the intrinsic generation process on the quotient space, the exact construction that removes symmetry redundancy, the framework simplifies learning by allowing model output to have an arbitrary intra-equivalence-class movement, while generating the correct symmetric target distribution with guarantee.
We instantiate the framework for molecular structure generation which follows SE(3) (rigid-body movement) symmetry.

evidence.anchor: molecular structure generation follows SE(3) symmetry

abstract_sentences.text: It improves the performance over equivariant diffusion models and outperforms alignment-based methods universally for small molecules and proteins, representing a new framework that surpasses previous symmetry treatments in generative models.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 把对称等价类内的无关运动从 diffusion 路径和学习 target 中分离：在 Q=M/G 上描述 essential process，用 horizontal lift 回到 M；P_x 去除 vertical movement，h̃ 补偿等价类体积变化，从而同时追求学习简化与 target fidelity。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 保留 Eq. (7–13) 的最小推导链、Theorems 1–4/Corollary 3、shape-space P_x/h̃/K、Table 1、Figure 3、Table 2–3；这些对象分别回答为何投影、为何正确、如何实现和是否有效。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 把 manifold/SDE 定义、free/proper/isometric 条件、fiber-volume proof、general-prior algorithms、训练超参/数据 split、FoldSeek 复核和收敛图移入 Appendix B–G；因此正文紧凑，但 curvature correction 与完整蛋白 metric 边界无法脱离附录独立核查。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 1 提供 radial-vs-jagged 总直觉，Figure 3 用同一 diatomic example 对照 target，Table 1 将 removal/variance/compatibility 分成机制轴，Theorem 2→Corollary 3→Theorem 4 把抽象保证接到可执行 operator。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 证据范围局限于 SE(3)、两个 molecular datasets 和一个 protein setup，缺少 seed/repeat/不确定性与 P/h̃ component ablation；此外“shorter trajectory”的证明直接给出 squared-speed integral inequality，而非直接的弧长估计。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 宣称去除 symmetry redundancy 又保持生成分布时，应按 equivalence class → projection/lift → sampler correction → distribution guarantee → matched mechanism experiment 排成可定位证据链，并分别用路径、target 和结果图表承载这些论证。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 适用于 group action、quotient 和 horizontal structure 可定义的生成模型；若 action 不 free、prior 不 invariant、需要 reward tilting 或 subspace transition density，必须重新处理 singular set、measure 与 sampler density，不能直接外推。
